description: Per-jurisdiction legal-entity registry attestation. R0 skeleton per ADR-2605263800 §3 (CorpRegistrySensor). Authored by `kotodama.organism.sensors.corp.corp_registry_sensor` after a passive-only fetch of an officially-published bulk archive (SEC EDGAR / JP EDINET / UK Companies House / SEDAR+ / ASIC / etc.). The `entityLei` field cross-links to `com.etzhayyim.corp.leiReference` for global cross-jurisdiction key resolution. Constitutional framing per ADR-2605263800: passive-only invariant (no live registry scraping), per-jurisdiction publication-redaction policy honored, vendor commercial-terminal imports (Bloomberg Terminal / Refinitiv / FactSet / Moody's Orbis / D&B Hoovers / Pitchbook / Crunchbase Pro) CONSTITUTIONALLY PROHIBITED per Charter Rider §2(e)+§2(c). Full schema with structural enforcement (per-field consts, vendor-terminal deny-list at lint) lands at W1.

jurisdictionIso3.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (uppercase). USA / JPN / GBR / DEU / FRA / CAN / AUS / etc.

entityLocalId.description: Per-jurisdiction canonical entity identifier (SEC CIK / EDINET 提出者 ID / UK CRN / JP 法人番号 / etc.).

entityLei.description: Optional GLEIF LEI 20-char. NULL when entity is not LEI-bearing. Cross-link target: com.etzhayyim.corp.leiReference.

datasetPinAt.description: AT URI of the originating com.etzhayyim.substrate.datasetPin record.
